literature.citation: Li, J.; Ruml, W.; Koenig, S. EECBS: A Bounded-Suboptimal Search for Multi-Agent Path Finding. AAAI 2021, 35, 12353-12362.
literature.scope: Published MAPF search control adapted to the unified time-slot reservation domain; not the authors' original code.

adaptation.name: EECBS-R
adaptation.resource_conflict: Shared edge-layer-lane, node-layer, vertical-transition or origin/destination resource slot
adaptation.low_level: Exact earliest-delay search over the declared route/layer/lane/speed alternatives and 2 s departure grid under per-flight resource bans
adaptation.high_level: OPEN lower bound plus focal selection at cost <= w * min(OPEN), secondary key number of resource conflicts
adaptation.warm_start: SPC-WSR schedule used as a common feasible incumbent for the main scale; no claim of an independent cold-start optimum at n=100
adaptation.structural_cost: Excluded from the baseline objective, matching the archived CP-SAT/CBS baseline; reported for the returned schedule

inference: Baseline contrasts are descriptive and separate from the prespecified three-test main family; seed is the paired unit. No significance claim is added post hoc.
